In this video, we take you through the latest ground update of *Package-04 of the Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor in Andhra Pradesh,* covering the section from *Sabbavaram to Kantakapalle.*
We start from the completed Package-03 section & travel towards *Sabbavaram Interchange (Exit-23)* on NH-16, covering the ongoing construction activities along the way.
In this video, you will see the progress of *earthwork, major structures, ROB construction, Interchange No. 22, Sabbavaram Interchange, Miyawaki plantation, & the toll plaza* being developed under Package-04.
